create_pdf.description: Creates a PDF file using the provided content/context data. The content is written into a PDF document and the generated PDF file path is returned.

create_text_file.description: Creates a text file using the provided content/context data. The content is saved into a .txt file and the generated text file path is returned.

send_email.description: Sends an email to the provided receiver email address using the content/context data as the email body.
